synthetic.label: SYNTHETIC: artificial frames generated by the test fixture builder to demonstrate classifier outcomes. This is not real imagery and not a coverage measurement.

scenarios.title: Street run
scenarios.description: 500 m route, one sequence, a frame every 5 m on the right-hand lane from 100 m to 400 m.
scenarios.expectation: One STREET_VIDEO segment 100-400 m, BIRDS_EYE_3D before and after.

scenarios.title: Short run
scenarios.description: Same road, but frames only cover 50 m (below the 60 m minimum run).
scenarios.expectation: No STREET_VIDEO: the whole route is BIRDS_EYE_3D (run_too_short).

scenarios.title: Gap of 14 m
scenarios.description: Frames every 14 m across 100-400 m (every consecutive gap is exactly 14 m; the limit is strict < 15 m).

scenarios.title: Gap of 16 m
scenarios.description: Frames every 16 m across 100-400 m (every consecutive gap is exactly 16 m; the limit is strict < 15 m).

scenarios.title: Opposite-lane frames
scenarios.description: Eastbound route. 61 frames on the correct right-hand lane plus 167 frames from the opposite carriageway (7 m left, heading reversed).
scenarios.expectation: Opposite-lane frames are all dropped (left_of_centerline); the street run comes only from the own-direction sequence.

scenarios.title: Opposite-lane frames only
scenarios.description: Same road, only the opposite carriageway has imagery.
scenarios.expectation: No usable frames: the whole route is BIRDS_EYE_3D.

scenarios.title: Interchange discontinuity
scenarios.description: One sequence runs continuously, but at 300 m the matched edge changes from a primary road to a motorway ramp on a bridge (a level change while the sequence continues).
scenarios.expectation: level_uncertain BIRDS_EYE_3D around 300 m; street video only on either side, not across the transition.

scenarios.title: Interchange sequence/heading jump
scenarios.description: Sequence A ends at 295 m and a different sequence B begins at 305 m on the next edge, with the heading relative to the road changing from -20 to +20 degrees.
scenarios.expectation: level_uncertain BIRDS_EYE_3D across the jump (sequence_jump and heading_jump).

scenarios.title: Bridge: two 80 m runs, 20 m gap
scenarios.description: Two 80 m runs separated by a 20 m gap (15 m to 30 m: a crossfade bridge, never RIFE-interpolated).
scenarios.expectation: One STREET_VIDEO segment with the 20 m gap listed as a bridge (not a handoff).

scenarios.title: Gap of 14.999 m between two runs
scenarios.description: Two 60 m runs (a frame every 5 m) joined by a gap of 14.999 m between the last frame of the first and the first frame of the second.
scenarios.expectation: RIFE tier: the two pieces form ONE run (no bridge); the gap is RIFE-eligible.

scenarios.title: Gap of exactly 15.000 m between two runs
scenarios.description: Two 60 m runs (a frame every 5 m) joined by a gap of 15.000 m between the last frame of the first and the first frame of the second.
scenarios.expectation: Bridge tier: ONE STREET_VIDEO segment with ONE bridge (crossfade, not RIFE).

scenarios.title: Gap of exactly 30.000 m between two runs
scenarios.description: Two 60 m runs (a frame every 5 m) joined by a gap of 30.000 m between the last frame of the first and the first frame of the second.
scenarios.expectation: Bridge tier (ceiling is inclusive): ONE STREET_VIDEO segment with ONE bridge.

scenarios.title: Gap of 30.001 m between two runs
scenarios.description: Two 60 m runs (a frame every 5 m) joined by a gap of 30.001 m between the last frame of the first and the first frame of the second.
scenarios.expectation: Handoff tier: TWO STREET_VIDEO segments with BIRDS_EYE_3D between, no bridge.

scenarios.title: Chain of three runs, two bridges
scenarios.description: Three 60 m runs separated by gaps of 20 m and 25 m, all one sequence (pairwise rule: each qualifying run joins the previous one, up to the 2-bridge cap).
scenarios.expectation: ONE STREET_VIDEO segment 50-275 m with TWO bridges (110-130 m and 190-215 m).

scenarios.title: Bridge cap: four runs, three valid gaps
scenarios.description: Four 60 m runs, one sequence, separated by gaps of 20 m, 25 m and 22 m. A segment may hold at most 2 bridges.
scenarios.expectation: STREET_VIDEO 50-275 m with TWO bridges, a BIRDS_EYE_3D handoff over the third gap (275-297 m), then the fourth run (297-357 m) as its own STREET_VIDEO segment with no bridge.

scenarios.title: Same-sequence rule: 20 m gap, different sequence_id
scenarios.description: Two 60 m runs separated by a 20 m gap, but the second run belongs to a different sequence_id.
scenarios.expectation: No bridge across the sequence change (the matcher keeps one sequence per edge, so the other run is dropped as other_sequence): ONE STREET_VIDEO segment with no bridges, the rest BIRDS_EYE_3D.
